title: Northbeam TechWorks Recovery Instruction: Labour Rebilled After a Refused Claim
content:
Where a plan's decision refuses a claim after work on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job was carried out as plan work, the labour of that line is rebilled to the customer as chargeable work.

## 1. The attendances of the line, and the day the entry carries

The attendances of the refused line are counted from the labour entries standing on the job other than those booked for the day the job was completed, and the entry the rebill books is stamped with the day the crew was dispatched, whatever attendances of that line its hours were drawn from.

## 2. The hours

The hours rebilled are the hours recorded for the day the crew was dispatched. The service's minimum hours are applied once to the hours taken.

## 3. The rate

The rate is the rate recorded on the labour of the day the crew was dispatched.

## 4. The gross figure

The hours and the rate are multiplied and the outcome rounded to the nearest cent, and the entry the rebill books carries those hours and that rate, while the amount billed on it is that gross figure less the credit allowed below.

## 5. What the gross figure is rebilled at

What the gross figure is rebilled at is settled next: the gross figure less what the plan has already paid out on the item, never below nothing and never more than the per-claim limit the plan carries, is rebilled. The payout history and the per-claim limit are read from the Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plans covering the item.

## 6. The two deductions

From the figure rebilled come the write-offs that already stand on the job. Nothing is credited for a diagnostic fee.

## 7. The amount billed on the line

What remains after those deductions, rounded to the nearest cent and never below nothing, is the labour billed on the line, and the line is billed to the customer once and is not claimed from the plan again.

## Worked figure on hypothetical inputs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job or plan on file.*

A hypothetical job under TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration, whose minimum hours are two and whose hourly rate is 159.00 USD an hour. The labour of the day the crew was dispatched records 3.5 hours at 159.00 USD an hour. The plan covering the item has already paid out 186.00 USD on it and carries a per-claim limit of 900.00 USD. Write-offs of 73.20 USD stand on the job, and a diagnostic charge stands on it too.

| Step | Figure |
| --- | --- |
| Hours rebilled, the hours recorded for the day the crew was dispatched | 3.5 |
| The minimum hours applied once to those hours | 3.5, the hours already exceeding two |
| The rate recorded on that labour | 159.00 |
| The gross figure, the hours multiplied by the rate and rounded to the cent | 556.50 |
| Less what the plan has already paid out on the item | 370.50 |
| Held to the per-claim limit of 900.00 | 370.50 |
| Less the write-offs standing on the job | 297.30 |
| Less the credit for a diagnostic fee, which is nothing | 297.30 |

The labour billed on the line is **297.30 USD**, and the entry carries 3.5 hours and the rate of 159.00 USD an hour.
